purpose: Immutable text-source inventory with conservative semantic reading coverage; not a media-validation or execution-success record.

reading_policy.full_text_read: Reserved for complete semantic reading during this task; no file is assigned this status.
reading_policy.relevant_sections_read: Only the listed inclusive one-based line ranges were semantically inspected. Other lines have inventory coverage only.
reading_policy.inventoried_only: Path, bytes, UTF-8 line count and SHA-256 were checked. No full semantic review is asserted, even if retrieval encountered keywords.
reading_policy.range_policy: Conservative list of known inspected passages; truncated tool output is not treated as full reading.
reading_policy.line_count_method: len(UTF-8 decoded text.splitlines()); inclusive ranges refer to physical source lines.
reading_policy.media_policy: Images, audio and video excluded from reading, parsing and effect validation.
reading_policy.translation_policy: Translations and vocabulary expansions are derivative texts, not independent generation experiments.
reading_policy.record_scope: Domain-rule extraction only; additional independent forward-use reads are recorded separately with those trials.

evidence_levels.F: Source fact: prompt or breakdown explicitly states this design; no inference-success guarantee.
evidence_levels.A: Author-reported result; not independently measured in this task.
evidence_levels.D: M3 design choice or engineering inference from identified source text; conditions and conflicts remain explicit.
evidence_levels.I: Actual implementation and execution evidence, limited to the recorded checks; not inference.
evidence_levels.U: Media and physical or visual outcomes not inspected or verified.
